pattern: a saved private password cannot reach a preview field
experience: After request_secret saved the password, the agent asked the user to paste it manually because browser typing did not accept secretRef.
rule: Use preview_act type with the saved secretRef, explicit tabId, and password locator. Do not re-ask or read the value.
